description: Replication package for "Convenience, accountability and implementation friction in European municipal waste systems" is published by Under blind review. The package combines waste indicators, policy dates and service-reporting evidence for a municipal-waste study. Its stated coverage is EU27 country-year data with Italian municipality and city-level evidence. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is cc-by-4.0. Mixed reporting units and hand-coded policy dates require the source ledger. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
